data.narrative:
Ouros Energy is a Seed-stage company in the Climate & Energy sector that has raised $3M+ to date. The comp universe consists of 9 peers in this sector, including 1 public company (Lnza) and 8 private firms such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, the narrow peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables to support a reliable peer-median valuation.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach. Using the $3M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the next stage yields an implied valuation of $8M. This method provides the primary quantitative anchor for the analysis.

The valuation range supported by this analysis is $6M to $9M, with a median point of $8M. The low end reflects conservative application of the multiplier, while the high end captures modest upside. The key uncertainty is the reliance on a single method; peer-median analysis could not be applied due to insufficient comparable data points at the same or adjacent stage within the Climate & Energy sector. Any valuation within the $6M–$9M range remains provisional pending access to a more robust set of early-stage climate-tech comparables or updated financial performance data from Ouros Energy itself.
